findings.message: 1 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "Free app"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 3 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: img.size-14.shrink-0 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.min-h-11.rounded-xl → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.inline-flex.min-h-11 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 18px (1.3vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The page has no visible h1.
findings.fix: Give the first screen a clear title in an h1 that says what this is (a name with what it does, the product with what it is for, the event with its date and place).

findings.message: 61% of the first screen is one empty block (1020×780px at 0,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: Only 6 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "A little happiness in every scoop" above "Your next favorite starts here."; "Celebrate with a cake" above "Cakes for every occasion"; "Our favorites" above "Fan favorites"; "Price" above "3,500 FCFA"; "Explore the menu" (pill) above "SUNSHINE"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "/ 03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 19 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "A little happiness in every scoop", "Featured", "Why people love us", "Celebrate with a cake").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 🍦 📱 🛵 ✨ 💳 ✦
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 23 gradient fill(s): div.hero-blob-a.absolute → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255, 220, 50, 0.12), rgba(255, 220, 50, 0.12) 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.hero-blob-b.absolute → radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(28, 79, 138, 0.5), rgba(28, 79, 138, 0.5) 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top, oklab(0.231324 -0.0156847 -0.0611215 / 0.85) 0%, oklab(0.231324 -0.0156847 -0.0611215
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 8 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): ul.mt-6.hidden 704px | section.border-b.border-[#e9e5da] 756px | div.mt-6.flex 630px | div.mt-8.flex 693px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 1 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 17 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #fbfaf5, section #f8f6f1).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: 25 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Cookie Mintster" (screen 8, 50% hidden); "3,500 FCFA" (screen 9, 100% hidden); "Menu highlights" (screen 12, 50% hidden); "All flavors" (screen 12, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Large text is cut off along its top by the box that holds it: "SUNSHINE" (screen 10)
findings.fix: Jurors read a wordmark sliced at the top as broken. Give the box room for the ascenders (line-height and padding), or crop at the bottom or a side edge on purpose.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Your next favorite starts here." → 3 lines (5 words, 46.4px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a
